summary: The current `Status::Update` overloads violate the documented first-error contract. The const overload replaces an existing error with a later error, and the rvalue overload moves an OK status into the receiver, clearing its error. These behaviors explain all three failing assertions in `Status.Update`.
hypotheses: `Update(const Status&)` overwrites an already non-OK receiver with a later non-OK status.
`Update(Status&&)` moves an OK input into the receiver, clearing an existing error.
